title: Best Audio Ad Producers (2026): Radio, Podcast and Streaming Ads
description: How to hire an audio ad producer for radio, podcast or streaming ads: script, voices, music, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Audio ad producers create short ads for radio, podcasts and music streaming services. They combine a script, voice actors, music and sound effects into a spot that grabs attention without pictures. Projects go wrong when the script is too long for the time slot, the call to action is hard to remember, or voice and music rights do not cover broadcast. This guide helps you get audio ads that are clear and ready to air.

faq.q: How long should an audio ad be?
faq.a: It depends on the platform. Common lengths are short spots of a set number of seconds. Ask the platform which lengths they accept.

faq.q: Does the producer write the script?
faq.a: Many do, or they edit yours. A script written for listening is very different from written ad copy.

faq.q: Are voice and music rights included?
faq.a: Confirm that voice talent and music are licensed for your media, regions and time period.
Each platform has technical specs for file type and loudness. Give the producer these specs.
